In the Form-III derivational family (verb jaahada/yujaahidu, participle mujaahid, masdar jihaad) this utmost exertion is realized as DIRECTED and dyadic — brought to bear toward a cause or against a resistant counterpart — but the target, instrument, and moral valence are supplied entirely by the syntactic complement (fii sabiili llaah / fii / bi- / direct object / li-tushrik), never by the root itself. internal_discovery.plain_explanation: The root names bringing effort to its maximum. When it appears in the Form-III pattern (the verb 'jaahada', the doer 'mujaahid', the verbal noun 'jihaad') it means to bring that maximal effort to bear on something — toward a goal or against an opponent — where WHAT the goal is, HOW (by wealth, by self, by the Qur'an), and whether it is good or evil are all fixed by the surrounding words, not by the root. In its plain noun forms jahd/juhd it means only 'the utmost extent' (of an oath) or 'all the capacity one can find', with no fighting and no direction at all.
internal_discovery.layer_separation_note: jhd does NOT entail: (1) armed combat/killing — the instrument is the Qur'an in 25:52 (jaahidhum bihi), wealth throughout (bi-amwaalihim), and mere charitable giving in 9:79; the war roots are qtl/Hrb, kept distinct. (2) positive/religious valence — in 29:8 and 31:15 the identical Form-III verb has disbelieving parents straining to force shirk, and the base noun frames false oaths (5:53, 6:109). (3) inherent direction or target — supplied by fii / bi- / object / maCa; the base noun is directionless. (4) success/outcome — 5:35 makes falaaH a hoped consequence (laCallakum tufliHuun), separate from the exertion. (5) synonymy with Sbr (endurance), hijra, or nfr/qCd — these are coordinated-with or opposed-to jhd, never merged (16:110, 3:142, 2:218, 4:95, 9:41).
internal_discovery.strongest_counterexample: 31:15:2:1 (twin 29:8:6:1) — wa-in jaahadaaka Calaa an tushrika bii: the same Form-III verb of the 'strive in God's way' cluster has PARENTS as agents and shirk as the aim. This decisively disproves that jhd (or Form III specifically) lexically encodes righteous/religious striving; valence and target live in the complement, not the root. The strongest RESISTER to any single-nucleus unification is the frozen base-noun idiom jahda aymaanihim (16:38, 24:53, 35:42, 5:53, 6:109) plus juhdahum (9:79): these carry only the scalar 'utmost degree/capacity' and never exhibit the directed exertion-against-resistance of the Form-III family — same gloss, not a Quran-internally demonstrated common operation.
internal_discovery.strongest_competitor: 'jhd = to fight/wage holy war in God's cause' (collapse into qtl/Hrb, driven by ~20 Form-III tokens carrying fii sabiili llaah, bi-amwaalihim wa-anfusihim, hijra-pairing, and the qaaCiduun contrast in 4:95). It is refuted Quran-internally: the instrument is the Qur'an in 25:52 and wealth/giving in 9:79 and passim, the parent-coercion uses (29:8, 31:15) are non-military and evil-aimed, 29:6 is used absolutely (whoever strives strives for himself), and the base nouns jahd/juhd carry no combat sense at all. internal_discovery.rationale: All three independent lenses converged on the same two-layer structure and the same grade. The taproot 'straining capacity to the utmost' bridges all 41 tokens, but stated broadly enough to cover the base nouns it becomes the vague-abstraction the contract warns against; the USEFUL, distinctive sense (directed maximal exertion, valence/target complement-borne) is confined to the morphologically-marked Form-III family (27 V(III) + 4 N(III) + 4 masdar = 35). A coherent, lexicalized nominal sub-class (jahda aymaanihim x5 + juhd x1 = 6) carries only the scalar component and diverges in valence, and by contract a resistant lexicalized/nominal sub-class caps strength at MODERATE and scope at REPRESENTATIVE. The account is not UNRESOLVED because the resistant class IS bridged at the thin taproot and the Form-III core is adversarially robust (the parents->shirk and Qur'an-instrument cases CONFIRM the valence/target-neutral reading rather than breaking it); it is not STRONG because that resistant sub-class exists. Hence PREFERRED / MODERATE / REPRESENTATIVE over the Form-III derivational family.

reconciliation.rationale: The account never claims positive valence; valence and aim are complement-borne (li-tushrik). The identical morphology with commended tokens confirms rather than falsifies the valence-neutral directed-exertion reading.
Same reconciliation as 29:8: this is the strongest evidence FOR the valence-neutral account, not against it; piety/impiety is in the complement, not the root.

Retained as CONSISTENT and flagged adversarial-boundary: the instrument bihi=the Qur'an shows the means is complement-supplied and non-martial, sharpening the negative boundary against combat without disturbing the cluster.
